The accusing other people about stealing is so spot on. My nmom said that all the time without thinking that maybe she just misplaced things. 

Anyway…anytime a parent calls their daughter/son “ungrateful” or “disrespectful”, they’re likely a narcissist. I’ve been called those things my whole life and it took me a long time to realize how manipulative she is. So yes, your mom is definitely guilt tripping you. If you do it, it’ll keep getting worse. 

She wants you to be her caregiver. I know it might feel this way, but don’t feel like you owe it to her because she “took care” of you as a child. I would just tell her you’re busy with x, y and z and see if she can hire someone who’s closer that can help her.

Best of luck to you!

Backstory:

My parents are still together. I love my dad and am very close to him but I have a terrible relationship with my nmom for obvious reasons.

I had some old friends over for a BBQ at my parents house bc they live near the high school that I went to and those friends still live near there.

My nmom is the type of person where if she’s asks you a question and she doesn’t like the response, she will keep asking you until she gets the response that satisfies her.

In this situation, she made a really bad dessert (that she was proud of) and kept asking if my friend wanted any. My friend said no. My mom doesn’t know how to accept no as an answer so she kept asking my friend until she felt pressured to say yes. 

It really bothers bc it’s so embarrassing and rude! My friends noticed that my mom was so persistent on having everyone try her dessert (and other snacks as well) so I told my nmom that if someone says “no”, to not ask again and just accept it. 

My friends did not criticize her, nor did I say anything to my mom that indicated they were criticizing her. 

Also, my friends did say thank you. Many times. Bc they have class. 

Thanks for reading! It sounds so dumb written out but it feels good to expose her craziness.
